candidate.title: ALGEBRAIC & TRANSCENDENTAL BRAUER-MANIN OBSTRUCTIONS ON FERMAT HYPERSURFACES
candidate.claim: The Brauer group Br(X) / Br(Q) of the generalized Fermat hypersurface X: A^x + B^y = C^z over Q creates an unramified Brauer-Manin obstruction to integral points.
candidate.method: Brauer-Manin obstruction (Manin, Colliot-Thelene, Skorobogatov), unramified cohomology H^2_{nr}(X, G_m), quaternion algebras.
obligations: Audit whether Brauer-Manin obstructions can detect integer coprimality.
candidate.failure_reason: For smooth projective hypersurfaces X in P^n of dimension >= 2, the Picard group Pic(X_bar) = Z H by the Lefschetz hyperplane theorem, so the algebraic Brauer group Br_1(X) / Br(Q) = 0; transcendental Brauer classes are torsion and invariant under scaling gcd(A, B, C) > 1 (Failure Mode 1).
candidate.novelty_note: Applies Brauer-Manin obstruction to generalized Fermat hypersurfaces.
extracted: Lefschetz hyperplane theorem implies Pic(X_bar) = Z, forcing Br_1(X)/Br(Q) = 0; Brauer-Manin cannot distinguish coprime from non-coprime integer points.
